issues: Three small cards (440×300) on a light grey stage occupied only a thin strip mid-frame; the fronts were grey placeholder lines and the backs had large empty areas around the number
A debug title 'CARD FLIP REVEAL' sat in the top-left corner; there was no real headline or story
The flip just rotated at an even pace with a small overshoot: no anticipation and no sense of weight lifting off the table
Both faces were white, so brightness never changed through the flip and the reveal had no punch
changes: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark, champagne-gold accent): dark feature fronts flip to porcelain-white result backs, so each flip is a dark-to-light inversion and the row ends as three white number posters

Content rewritten for a fictional writing tool, Quill: Compose / Summaries / Search on 480×620 portrait bento cards with large UI (≥28px); backs carry 158px figures 3.2× / −41% / 0.2s, a 34px result line and a before/after comparison bar
A gold kicker and an 84px headline, 'Three features. Three outcomes.', rise word by word top-left; the three cards span 1536px, 80% of the frame

Three-phase flip: 4f lean-back anticipation, 16f accelerating turn to 194°, spring settle to 180°; cards lift 60px mid-flip, faces darken with angle, and a narrow edge light tracks the rotation near 90°

The cards stand on a dark mirror floor with synchronised flipping reflections and contact shadows that track the projected width; 12f stagger, a 78f hold after the last card lands, and a slow 3% push-in
